key.name: light-style
key.description: Whether the glass, the panel and GNOME's menus turn light while GNOME's dark style is off. Off: always dark, prefer-light included.

key.name: accent-tint
key.description: Whether GNOME's accent colour is mixed into the glass and the surfaces on it.

key.name: accent-scale
key.description: The accent's strength, in per cent of the designed look: at 100, 8 % of the accent over the glass, 25 % in the surfaces on it, 6 % in an open folder's card in the light case; in the dark one 12.5 and 9 %, and over the glass 3.2 % for purple and less for a lighter accent; all scale together.

key.name: dark-depth-scale
key.description: How far the dark glass is taken from mid-grey toward black, in per cent of the designed look: its lightness, which follows the wallpaper, 12 higher at 50 and 12 lower at 150.

key.name: light-depth-scale
key.description: How far the light glass is taken from mid-grey toward white, in per cent of the designed look: its lightness 75 at 50, 80 at 100, 85 at 150.
